brief:
An Australian-Palestinian physician with an approved visa and official invitation from a health diplomacy charity was turned away at two separate West Bank border crossings, the doctor reported to The Guardian. The medical professional, who was born in Palestine and studied there, attempted entry this month as part of a health-related initiative but was denied passage on both occasions despite holding proper documentation.

The incident raises questions about entry procedures at West Bank crossings and the treatment of Palestinians holding foreign passports attempting to return to the territory.

title: Australian-Palestinian doctor denied West Bank entry despite valid visa
